device.description: 12-bit 1 MSPS 2-channel unipolar SAR ADC with SPI/DSP serial interface, TAG bit and daisy chain
device.note: ads7229.pdf (SBAS437A, ADS7229/ADS7230) p.3-7 electrical characteristics (+VBD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9 timing at +VBD = 1.8 V, p.10-11 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.25-26 converter operation, conversion start, EOC/INT, p.27-28 power-down, p.31-33 digital interface (Table 3 CMR commands, Table 4 CFR, Table 5 codes, TAG), p.33-36 chain mode, Table 6, p.37 reset

registers.name: CFR
registers.note: p.32 Table 4: configuration register, default all 1s (ADS7229: D1 ignored, reads 0); no address (CMR commands 1100b/1110b/1111b)

registers.name: CHSEL
registers.note: internal: the channel chosen by the CMR select-channel commands 0h/1h (ADS7230)

commands.name: Select analog input channel 0
commands.note: p.31 Table 3: takes effect at the 4th SCLK falling edge; also wakes from auto nap

commands.name: Wake up
commands.note: p.31-32: sets CFR D3 and D2 to 1

commands.name: Read CFR
commands.note: p.31: the read-back is the first four result MSBs then the 12-bit CFR

commands.name: Write CFR (D0 = 0: system reset)
commands.note: p.32 Table 4 D0: 0 = system reset (all registers to default, all 1s)

commands.name: Write CFR
commands.note: p.31: 4-bit command plus 12 bits of CFR data, effective at the 16th SCLK falling edge

commands.name: Default mode (load CFR with default value)
commands.note: p.31-32: CFR loaded with all 1s at the 4th falling edge (SDI tied to +VBD gives this every cycle)

pages: p.2 (ordering: RSA QFN-16, PW TSSOP-16), p.3-7 (electrical characteristics, +VBD 1.65-5.5 V, digital inputs to +VBD + 0.3 V), p.9 (timing at +VBD = 1.8 V: internal CCLK 20 MHz min, tD1 16 ns, tD2 13 ns, tD3 8 ns), p.10-11 (pin drawings and terminal functions), p.25-26 (18-CCLK conversion, CONVST falling edge, Table 1, EOC/INT), p.31 (digital interface, Table 3), p.32 (Table 4 CFR), p.32-33 (data format, Table 5 straight binary, TAG), p.36 (Table 6), p.37 (reset)
notModeled: analog input and external reference: every conversion returns the 0 V code 000h

conversion time is 18 CCLK at the 20 MHz minimum internal clock (900 ns); CCLK = SCLK/2 (CFR D10 = 0), the 21-CCLK auto-trigger cycle (D9 = 0) and the minimum CONVST spacing are not timed; with auto trigger the model converts back to back every 900 ns
quiet zone around end of sampling and the pipelined result (reading before end of conversion gives the previous result): the model always outputs the constant 0 V code
SDO outputs all 1s during the first cycle after power-on or software reset (the model outputs the normal frame)
daisy-chain mode (CFR D5 = 0: EOC/INT/CDI becomes the chain data input, 16/24-SCLK pass-through); with D5 = 0 the pin is left inactive
power-down modes: deep power-down (D2), nap (D3), auto nap (D4) and their wake-up times; CFR bits are stored only, Wake up sets D3/D2
the 4-bit CMR is not readable; the CFR read-back reply starts after the 4 command bits (the 4 result MSBs before it are the frame's normal output)

auto channel select (CFR D11 = 1, the power-on default) alternating channel 0 and 1: the channel only changes with the select-channel commands; the TAG bit (17th SCLK, CHSEL.CH) is output even when TAG is disabled (CFR D1 = 0, where that bit is 0)
variants: ADS7229 (single-channel: +IN/-IN, RESERVED pin, no channel commands, CFR D1 reads 0) shares ads7229.pdf; own spec
